title: Rubik and Jabs reanalyse the Michelson-Morley ether data
summary: Diane Powell tells of Rubik and Jabs reanalyse the Michelson-Morley ether data, about 1890s experiment; later paper at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Beverly Rubik who's a biophysicist um and Harry Jabs who's a physicist they looked at that data and and and they wrote a paper basically saying well wait a minute there actually was an effect

plain: In the 1890s, the scientists Michelson and Morley ran a famous experiment looking for the ether, a substance once thought to fill all of space. A researcher named Diane Powell, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says a biophysicist named Beverly Rubik and a physicist named Harry Jabs later looked at that data again and wrote a paper saying there actually was an effect. If true, it would reopen a question most of physics considers closed.
